body.label: Target
body.html: Self or one willing ally within 4 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. The target moves up to 2 units and resists its next 1 unit of forced movement until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: The target ignores difficult terrain during the movement.

rider.title: Rite - Imbuement
rider.html: Rite, 2 Echoes: bind the target. Trigger: it ends voluntary movement adjacent to a willing ally or a solid obstacle. Echo: gain +1 Fortitude against the next attack targeting it before your next turn.
